On behalf of the Bentwood Creek Homeowners Association, we would like to extend a warm welcome to you and your family. The fact that you have chosen Bentwood Creek as your new home is a major complement to our neighborhood. We are sure that you chose Bentwood Creek in part for its natural beauty as well as the “pride of ownership” shown by our homeowners.

Our association is managed by an elected board of directors in partnership with Crye-Leike Community Association Management Company. Please familiarize yourself with two very important governing documents that are vital to us maintaining the high standard in our neighborhood. The first is the Declaration of Covenants and secondly is the Architectural Controls. We operate an Architectural Control Committee that reports to the board of directors. Please remember that any change to the exterior of your home or property requires the approval of this committee

There are many opportunities for you to serve the association as active committees include social, landscape and lighting, architectural control as well as a flag committee responsible for placing American flags at our entrances at specific times during the year.

We would like to make the transition to your new home as smooth as possible. In order to assist with communication, please provide Crye-Leike with your phone number and email address, and please "Subscribe To Our Communications" by adding your email address at the bottom of the page. Please contact a board member if we my assist you in any way.

Sincerely,

Bentwood Creek HOA
